dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you saying Nasha Town is noisier than it used to be?

dialogues.speaker: Pentti
dialogues.text: Ha! If this is the crowd we're attracting nowadays, I'd rather Nasha Town went back to being a sleepy little market town! Where did this madhouse of shops spring up from, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Pentti
dialogues.text: Back in the day, the only thing the market sold was seafood fresh off the boat. No fancy seasoning required — just whack it in some hot water and let the flavor stay with you all day...

dialogues.speaker: Pentti
dialogues.text: *sigh* But those times are gone now. It's enough to make you want to cry...
